title:
Used to handle user navigating away from the asset hierarchy viewer.
The epic handles following things:
1. Force redirect to asset hierarchy viewer page: On 'Reliability.ConfigPageTitle.ACTIVE_TAB_SET', the epic
     - Starts listening to any GLOBAL_REDIRECT's happening and force redirects user back to the asset hierarchy viewer page via a helper.
     - The epic also stores the page user originally intended to navigate to in application state and opens a warning modal.
     - Stops helper listening, when GLOBAL_REDIRECT is fired with payload having 'exitAnyway' parameter set to true.

2. Exit anyway from asset's model config page: On 'GLOBAL_REDIRECT' with 'exitAnyway' set to true, the epic
     Fires 'GLOBAL_REDIRECT' to page user originally intended to navigate to and clear relevant application state.
name: ExitEditAssetHierarchyEpic
